title: Music
blurb: Instruments, orchestras, composers, and music around the world.

hr.title: Glazba
hr.blurb: Instrumenti, orkestri, skladatelji i glazba svijeta.

questions.fact: Cristofori built his first piano in Italy around 1700. One from 1720 is the oldest piano that survives today.

hr.fact: Cristofori je prvi klavir napravio u Italiji oko 1700. Jedan iz 1720. najstariji je sačuvani klavir na svijetu.

questions.q: True or false: The world's oldest surviving piano has no pedals.
questions.fact: Cristofori's 1720 piano at the Met in New York has no pedals, unlike modern pianos.

hr.q: Točno ili netočno: najstariji sačuvani klavir na svijetu nema pedala.
hr.fact: Cristoforijev klavir iz 1720. u muzeju Metropolitan u New Yorku nema pedala, za razliku od današnjih.

questions.q: How many keys does a standard modern piano have?
questions.fact: Those 88 keys cover a little more than seven octaves.

hr.q: Koliko tipki ima standardni moderni klavir?
hr.fact: Tih 88 tipki obuhvaća nešto više od sedam oktava.

questions.q: Which composer kept writing music after losing most of his hearing?
questions.fact: His Ninth Symphony premiered in Vienna in 1824, when he was profoundly deaf.

hr.q: Koji je skladatelj nastavio skladati nakon što je izgubio većinu sluha?
hr.fact: Njegova Deveta simfonija prvi je put izvedena u Beču 1824., kad je bio gotovo potpuno gluh.

questions.q: At about what age did Mozart compose his first music?
questions.fact: Mozart wrote his first little pieces around 1761, when he was about five years old.

hr.q: Otprilike s koliko je godina Mozart skladao svoju prvu glazbu?
hr.fact: Mozart je svoje prve male skladbe napisao oko 1761., kad mu je bilo oko pet godina.

questions.q: How many strings does a standard violin have?
questions.fact: The violin's four strings are tuned to the notes G, D, A, and E.

hr.fact: Četiri žice violine ugođene su na tonove G, D, A i E.

questions.q: The trumpet belongs to which family of instruments?
questions.fact: Brass players make sound by buzzing their lips into a cup-shaped mouthpiece.

hr.fact: Svirači limenih puhala proizvode zvuk zujanjem usana u čašicu usnika.

questions.q: Who leads an orchestra while standing in front of it?
questions.fact: Many conductors use a thin stick called a baton to show the beat.

hr.q: Tko vodi orkestar stojeći ispred njega?
hr.fact: Mnogi dirigenti pokazuju ritam tankim štapićem koji se zove dirigentska palica.

questions.q: The sitar is a stringed instrument from which country?
questions.fact: A sitar has extra strings that no one plucks. They ring along on their own and make its shimmering sound.

hr.q: Sitar je žičani instrument iz koje zemlje?
hr.fact: Sitar ima dodatne žice koje nitko ne trza. One titraju same od sebe i daju mu svjetlucav zvuk.

questions.q: The didgeridoo comes from which country?
questions.fact: Aboriginal Australians traditionally make didgeridoos from tree branches hollowed out by termites.

hr.fact: Australski Aboridžini tradicionalno rade didžeridue od grana koje su iznutra izdubili termiti.
